D:/Programs/mingw64/bin/gcc -Wall -O0 -o demo14 demo14_linkqueue.c && ./demo14  # 链队列
D:/Programs/mingw64/bin/gcc -Wall -O0 -o demo15 demo15_expr.c && ./demo15       # 表达式求值（双栈）
D:/Programs/mingw64/bin/gcc -Wall -O0 -o demo16 demo16_stack_sim.c && ./demo16  # 显式栈模拟递归
D:/Programs/mingw64/bin/gcc -Wall -O0 -o demo17 demo17_ex.c && ./demo17         # 回文/双栈队列/size法
